name: Minami Nadeshiko
source:
The young wife of the head of the personnel department.
She is the weakest "meat pot" along with Aoi, the nurse. She cares about her husband so much that she falls for a single panty shot.
She has a modest and quiet personality, and is not good at socializing with neighbors. Her specialty is making a troubled face with a smile.
There are rumors that she is having trouble in her marriage.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040429210739/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]the game's site, archived[/url]]
